headline: Caixa Econômica Federal Realiza Sorteio da Mega-Sena de R$ 75 Milhões
metaDescription: Caixa Econômica Federal holds the Mega-Sena draw for contest 3091 this Thursday, featuring an estimated main prize pool of 75 million Brazilian Reais.
aiSummaryBullets: The Caixa Econômica Federal is conducting the Mega-Sena draw for contest 3091.
The jackpot prize for this specific lottery event is estimated at 75 million Reais.
The drawing is scheduled to take place at 9 p.m. on Thursday, November 26.
aiContextParagraph: The Caixa Econômica Federal regularly organizes various lottery draws in Brazil, including the Mega-Sena, which is one of the most popular gaming events in the country. Following a recent period where the prize pool accumulated, the upcoming contest 3091, scheduled for the evening of November 26, 2026, carries an estimated jackpot of 75 million Reais. Participants follow these recurring events to check their numbers against the official results published by the bank. Lottery draw schedules are consistent, with multiple contests often occurring throughout the week for games such as Lotofácil, Dia de Sorte, and Lotomania, providing frequent opportunities for public participation. These lottery activities remain a central point of interest for many Brazilians, with results typically broadcast or released by the national financial institution shortly after the drawing process concludes.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to high public interest, matched by strong search signals for the 75 million prize and coverage across four independent media outlets.
